scope: Finite feasibility of the exact 259-square certificates; no optimality, priority, or provenance-chain verdict
inputs_allowed_before_freeze: first three lines of author README
source_observations_before_declaration: JSON schema with n=259, rational side, side_decimal, centers cx/cy and t; YAML corners header and sample coordinates; author README opening identifies t as rational half-angle tangent and asserts an upward-rounded side. No feasibility computations or external checker code read.
accept_rule: Both independently parsed encodings must contain exactly 259 unit squares, all vertices inside the closed rational container, and each of all 33411 pairs must admit an exact separating line. All declared controls must produce expected outcomes. Exact vertex sets and side must agree across encodings for correspondence; no tolerances.

methods.json: Construct exact rational orthonormal axes from t=a/b using (b^2-a^2,2ab)/(b^2+a^2). Check containment by center support radius and all unordered pairs using the four unit support axes. Integer cross multiplication decides all inequalities.
methods.yaml: Parse the supplied corners directly with a strict, restricted grammar. Independently clear denominators per polygon. Check consecutive unit orthogonal edges, parallelogram closure and positive signed area. Check every corner against every wall. For each pair test whether some oriented edge of either square places all four corners of the other in its closed exterior half-plane, using integer cross products.

shared_assumptions: CPython 3.14.7 integer arithmetic, Fraction parsing/normalization, and operating system/file reads
The source files supplied by the coordinator are the original attachment members (chain of custody not independently checked)

controls.input: two axis-aligned unit squares with centers (1/2,1/2),(3/2,1/2), side 2
two axis-aligned unit squares with centers (1/2,1/2),(3/2,3/2), side 2
edge_contact with second cx decreased by 10^-100
rotated_edge_contact with center difference multiplied by 1-10^-100
swap two adjacent supplied corners of unit square
scale unit square corners about origin by 1-10^-100
remove last square but preserve n=259
replace second square geometry with first geometry, preserving count and distinct YAML ids
zero denominator and non-finite scalar text
append an unsupported nonempty source line

workload: One Python worker, sequential checks, no builds, observe-only memory_guard. Full pairwise scans have a 120-second workload ceiling; no approximate or broad-phase exclusions.
